data.turoyo: W bəṯər məd grəfle, han naqqa gəd gurašwo tawno, gurašwo ʕarʕuro w mgandarwo i goro lašan d lə doləf.
data.translation: Uncle Ishoʕ: At that time all the people would shovel their roofs. On the roofs, at that time there was no cement or anything like that. All the roofs were earth. Whenever the snow came, everyone would go up onto his roof with a shovel in his hand. The wooden shovel in his hand, and he would shovel. And afterwards, when he had shovelled it, then he would spread straw, spread ʕarʕuro, and roll the roof so that it would not leak.
